trigger_condition: profile/local-override defines codeMieProject or codeMieIntegration but no codeMieUrl of its own
guard_snippet: still fall back to workspace.codeMieUrl when identity.codeMieUrl is undefined before the early return
potential_consequence: resolved config.codeMieUrl becomes undefined even though a same-name global profile or workspace has one, silently disconnecting the profile

trigger_condition: first same-server workspace layer defines only part of the identity trio (e.g. url only, no project)
guard_snippet: continue to the next layer for still-undefined keys instead of unconditional break after the first matching layer
potential_consequence: a project/integration available on the next (e.g. global) workspace is never picked up even though it is on the same server

trigger_condition: a workspace defines codeMieProject/codeMieIntegration but has no codeMieUrl of its own
guard_snippet: require workspace.codeMieUrl to be defined and match before letting it contribute project/integration, not just 'missing counts as match'
potential_consequence: a URL-less workspace's project/integration is applied to a profile pointed at a different server, reintroducing cross-server bleed

trigger_condition: codemie profile (list) run for a profile lacking its own codeMieUrl, versus codemie profile status for the same active profile
guard_snippet: resolve workspaceCodeMieUrl per listed profile via ConfigLoader.load({name}).codeMieUrl (same path handleStatus now uses) instead of the raw ConfigLoader.resolveWorkspace(workingDir).codeMieUrl
potential_consequence: profile list shows a different (or present vs. absent) codeMieUrl than profile status for the same profile

trigger_condition: an install that already ran migration 007 (workspace defined, identity stripped from every profile) upgrades to this change without a follow-up migration
guard_snippet: add a migration that copies each scope's existing workspace identity back onto its active/each profile so hasIdentity(profile) becomes true again
potential_consequence: already-migrated users keep sharing one workspace-level codeMieUrl across all profiles — the exact isolation bug this diff exists to fix stays unfixed until every profile is manually resaved

trigger_condition: active profile defines codeMieProject/codeMieIntegration without its own codeMieUrl (the case resolveIdentity() now treats as unresolved)
guard_snippet: mirror resolveIdentity()'s early-return rule instead of unconditionally falling back to config.workspace?.codeMieUrl
potential_consequence: the Claude statusline budget check silently queries a different CodeMie server than ConfigLoader.load()/profile status would resolve for that same profile

trigger_condition: profile.codeMieUrl is stored as an empty string rather than absent
guard_snippet: use profile.codeMieUrl || workspaceCodeMieUrl (or an explicit falsy check) instead of the nullish-only ??
potential_consequence: display shows a blank URL instead of falling back to the workspace-resolved one
